ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface accounting for approximately 85-90% of the area, contrasted by 10-15% high-intensity white pixels localized in discrete spots and clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity clusters at the distal tips; dense white micro-speckling along the lower margins of both lobes; sparse circular grey-white mottling located in the medial and mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the central-to-mid trailing edge; high-frequency irregular topography at distal tips caused by biological encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Consistent convex curvature extending from the median notch to the lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white clusters at the extreme distal tips; multiple low-intensity circular spots (5-12 pixel diameter) scattered across the central dark fields of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct linear mark on the upper right lobe quadrant oriented diagonally; several faint, short vertical linear marks near the lower central region near the spray zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustations at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes, significantly altering the expected geometric profile of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-contrast 'salt-and-pepper' speckling pattern localized primarily along the lower anterior margins of both lobes.
